Settings

Display
Recursive OFL · one family, axes do all the work
Text
Recursive OFL
Mono
Recursive OFL · MONO axis at 1
Moves
variable-font axis motion, kinetic type
Mood
playful, friendly, curious, bright
Case
Sentence case; the loose (casual) setting only on display lines and labels, the strict one on body.
Numerals and features
font-variation-settings: "CASL" 1, "CRSV" 1, "slnt" -12

Ready, set, a g yReady, set, a g y

Cursive forms (CRSV) swap in single-storey a and g once slant passes -14.
Signature
One play of the axes: on load the headline letters ease from strict to casual (CASL 0 to 1) and lean in one by one over 900 ms, then hold still. Hover on a label repeats it for that label only.
Use when
Games, toys, learning apps for older kids and adults, creative tools, friendly consumer products.
Turns into slop when
When the axes loop forever, when every element wobbles, or when the casual setting is used for body text and forms.
Offline
Without network the page falls back to the system stacks in --f-display and --f-text; no font files ship with this specimen.
